newsitem.title: USA: New York group has 5.71 pct of Worldtex.
newsitem.headline: New York group has 5.71 pct of Worldtex.

text.p: A group of New York investors said on Tuesday that it has acquired 825,699 common shares of Worldtex Inc., or 5.71 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it acquired the stake for about $4.35 million for investment purposes.

The group includes investment partnerships EGS Associates LP, Bev Partners LP and Jonas Partners LP, as well as general partners William Ehrman, Frederic Greenberg, Frederick Ketcher, Jonas Gerstl and James McLaren.
It said it bought 186,400 of its shares between Sept. 9 and Nov. 21 at prices ranging from $6.06 to $9.25 each.
